refreshNotes: For MY25 in the US, Polestar drastically pruned the lineup to a single fully-loaded variant: Long Range Dual Motor with the Performance Pack standard. The previous separate Single Motor and base Dual Motor trims were dropped. The car otherwise carried over the MY24 hardware refresh (82 kWh battery, rear-biased dual-motor layout, 205 kW DC peak charging). Sources: https://carbuzz.com/cars/polestar/2/2025/, https://www.polestar-forum.com/threads/us-2025-polestar-2-fully-loaded-with-performance-pack-only.15052/, https://recharged.com/articles/2025-polestar-2-buying-guide
